agendaItems.title: Declaring the Day of October 20, 2026, as Community Media Day.
Declaring the Month of October 2026 as Arts and Humanities Month.
Declaring the Month of October 2026 as Domestic Violence Awareness Month.

First Reading of Ordinance No. 147, 2026, Establishing a Temporary Moratorium on the Acceptance or Processing of Land Use Applications, Permit Applications, and Other Applications Seeking Approval to Construct or Operate Certain Data Centers.
Items Related to Water Storage for the City Water Utility.
Possible consideration of the initiation of new ordinances and/or resolutions by Councilmembers.
Consideration of a motion to adjourn this meeting until after the completion of the Water Utility Enterprise Board business:

bullets.text: Council reviews water‑storage strategy, comparing Halligan and NISP.
Motion to withdraw Halligan permit application; passed 7‑0.
Motion to approve participation in NISP; passed 6‑1.
Motion to adopt Ordinance 148‑2026 transferring Halligan funds; passed 6‑1.
Motion to adopt six‑month data‑center moratorium; passed 7‑0.
Council adjourns after approving water‑storage and data‑center decisions.
